answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure node cluster, verified by a rhythm-based audit of heartbeat pulses that act like quartz oscillators to confirm exclusive occupancy. An honest agent pays for its unique reservation, while 1,000 fakes must forge parallel requests, incurring immense costs. A verifier checks the stream like a river to ensure no overlap, and any lapse triggers permanent identity revocation.
